title: PV bleeding in early pregnancy: ruptured ectopic
stem: Resus 3. A 29-year-old woman has lower abdominal pain and light vaginal bleeding; her last period was 7 weeks ago. She fainted at home. HR 118, BP 86/50, RR 22, SpO2 98%, GCS 15. She says she might be pregnant.
notes:
Checked against NICE NG126 (Ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage, 2019, updated 2023), RCOG/AEPU guidance and ATLS principles for haemorrhage.

Any woman of reproductive age with abdominal pain, bleeding or collapse needs a pregnancy test. Shock with a positive test is a ruptured ectopic until proven otherwise: resuscitate (two large-bore cannulae, crossmatch, blood early), call the gynaecology team for theatre (laparoscopy or laparotomy), and do not delay for formal ultrasound. A bedside ultrasound showing an empty uterus and free fluid supports the diagnosis. Anti-D is given to rhesus-negative women having surgery for an ectopic pregnancy (NICE). Shoulder-tip pain suggests haemoperitoneum.

Your notes list the topic 'PVB early pregnancy' without detail; nothing conflicts. Stable women with a suspected ectopic go to the early pregnancy assessment unit for transvaginal ultrasound and serum hCG.

steps.hint: Short and targeted: LMP, pain, bleeding, shoulder tip, risk factors.

Pregnancy.rz: 七個禮拜前。上個禮拜驗過——係有咗。
Pregnancy.r: Seven weeks ago. I did a test last week — positive.
Pregnancy.mark: Establishes a positive pregnancy and gestation

Pregnancy.tz: 今次有咗有冇照過超聲波？
Pregnancy.mark: Asks whether an intrauterine pregnancy has been confirmed

Symptoms.rz: 三個鐘前突然好刺痛，喺左邊下腹。而家成個肚都痛。
Symptoms.r: Sudden, sharp, left lower belly, 3 hours ago. Now all over.

Symptoms.rz: 有，瞓低嗰陣右邊膊頭尖好痛。
Symptoms.r: Yes, my right shoulder tip hurts when I lie down.

Risks.t: Previous ectopic, pelvic infection, tubal surgery, coil, IVF?
Risks.tz: 以前有冇試過宮外孕、盆腔炎、做過輸卵管手術、有冇放避孕環，或者做過人工受孕？
Risks.rz: 兩年前有過衣原體感染。
Risks.r: I had chlamydia two years ago.

Risks.rz: 我諗係 O 型 Rh 陰性。

steps.label: Resuscitate
steps.hint: Two cannulae, bloods and crossmatch, urine or serum hCG, blood early.

opts.t: Two large-bore cannulae; FBC, crossmatch 4 units, clotting, group and antibodies
Urine pregnancy test now (and serum hCG)
Send her to the early pregnancy unit for a scan tomorrow
opts.r: She is shocked. Theatre, not tomorrow's clinic.

steps.label: Examine
steps.hint: Abdomen; bedside ultrasound. No need for a speculum before theatre in shock.

Abdomen.r: Distended, generalised tenderness and guarding, worst in the left iliac fossa.

Bedside ultrasound.r: Empty uterus; free fluid in the pouch of Douglas; a left adnexal mass.
Bedside ultrasound.mark: Ultrasound: empty uterus, free fluid, adnexal mass

steps.label: Phone
steps.hint: Gynaecology registrar for theatre now; anti-D.

opts.t: Gynaecology: suspected ruptured ectopic, shocked, haemoperitoneum — emergency laparoscopy/laparotomy
opts.r: Gynae registrar: Theatre is ready, bring her up.

opts.t: Anti-D immunoglobulin because she is rhesus negative
opts.mark: Anti-D for a rhesus-negative woman having surgery

opts.r: Methotrexate is for stable, unruptured ectopics with low hCG. She has ruptured.

qs.q: Which woman needs a pregnancy test?
qs.a: Any woman of reproductive age with abdominal pain, bleeding or collapse
wrong: Only if she says she is pregnant
Only if her period is late

qs.q: Shoulder-tip pain in ectopic pregnancy is due to…
wrong: Referred pain from a tubal spasm
A spontaneous pneumothorax on that side

qs.a: Stable, unruptured, no heartbeat, hCG under 1500 IU/L
wrong: Stable, unruptured, fetal heartbeat seen, hCG 4000 IU/L
Heterotopic pregnancy with a live IUP
No, anti-D is not needed before 12 weeks

badge.name: Tube Watch
badge.flavor: Positive test plus shock: theatre now.

cards.q: Collapse, abdominal pain and a positive pregnancy test: think…

options: Empty uterus, free fluid, adnexal mass
Intrauterine gestational sac with a yolk sac
Normal ovaries and no free fluid
cards.why: Pseudo-sac can mimic an intrauterine sac.

cards.q: Anti-D in early pregnancy loss (NICE) is given for…
options: All women with bleeding in early pregnancy
Rh-negative women on medical management only
cards.why: Not needed for medical management or threatened miscarriage.

options: Combined oral contraceptive pill for many years

cards.why: No pain, no heartbeat, unruptured, able to follow up.

cards.q: Where is ectopic free fluid first seen on ultrasound?
cards.why: The most dependent part of the pelvis.
